import React from "react"; import GoalCard from "./GoalCard"; const Dashboard = ({ goals, income, onRemoveGoal, onShowGoalForm, onEditGoal, totalMonthlyNeeded, sortBy, setSortBy, onShowGoalWizard }) => { return (
Total Savings Needed
${goals.reduce((sum, g) => sum + g.amount, 0).toLocaleString()}
Monthly Disposable Income: ${income.toLocaleString()}

Your Goals

Total Saved: ${goals.reduce((sum, g) => sum + g.saved, 0).toLocaleString()}
Progress: {goals.length ? Math.round(goals.reduce((sum, g) => sum + g.saved, 0) / goals.reduce((sum, g) => sum + g.amount, 0) * 100) : 0}%
Monthly Savings Needed: ${totalMonthlyNeeded ? totalMonthlyNeeded.toLocaleString() : 0}
Savings vs Income: {income < totalMonthlyNeeded ? 'Not enough income' : 'On track'}
{goals.map((goal, idx) => ( ))}
); }; export default Dashboard;
